question: Should fresh standard StepFun onboarding move to `step-3.7-flash` now, while Step Plan remains on `step-3.5-flash` until StepFun documents 3.7 support for that product?
rationale: The standard endpoint supports Step 3.7 Flash, but changing its default reverses a deliberate recent choice; repository evidence cannot determine the desired rollout policy without owner intent.

options.title: Approve split rollout
options.body: Use Step 3.7 Flash for new standard StepFun setups while preserving Step 3.5 Flash for Step Plan.

options.title: Preserve both defaults
options.body: Keep both providers on Step 3.5 Flash until maintainers intentionally schedule a coordinated default migration.

options.title: Pause the proposal
options.body: Close or defer this PR if model availability alone is not enough reason to change onboarding defaults.

recommendation.title: Approve split rollout
recommendation.body: Use Step 3.7 Flash for new standard StepFun setups while preserving Step 3.5 Flash for Step Plan.

likelyOwner.reason: This person merged the recent catalog change that explicitly retained the existing defaults and is already the named decision recipient in the discussion.
